line: Good evening, and welcome to the Cotton Bowl! It's the Red River Rivalry, Texas and Oklahoma, under the lights in Dallas!
And here come the Longhorns, right out of the smoke! Listen to this place, it is shaking!
Fireworks over Fair Park, and a sellout crowd split right down the fifty.
Tonight it comes down to the quarterback's arm. Let's play some football!
Howdy, folks! Welcome to the State Fair of Texas!
Blue eighty! Blue eighty! Set... Hut!
Omaha! Omaha! Ready... Set... Hut!
White twenty-two! White twenty-two! Set, hut!
Black forty! Black forty! Hut, hut!
He's in! Touchdown! The Cotton Bowl explodes!
Fires it into the end zone... caught! Touchdown!
Oh, what a throw! Right on the money, and that's six!
Intercepted! Picked off, and the defense has it!
Oh, he never saw that defender. That's a costly pick.
Pressure... and he's sacked! Brought down hard!
Nowhere to go! The pocket collapsed and they got him.
Deep shot... caught! A huge gain, and the crowd is on its feet!
That's a big-time throw! Dropped it right in the bucket!

Caught for a nice gain.
And that'll move the chains. First down!
Moving the sticks! First down.
Right through his hands! Dropped!
Oh, he's got to catch that one. That's right on him.

Fourth down. This is the play of the game right here.
Fourth down, and they're going for it! Gutsy call!
Final seconds ticking away... it all comes down to this!
He's out of the pocket! Scrambling!
And that's a timeout on the field.
He spikes it to stop the clock.
Here we go, from the Cotton Bowl. It's Red River Saturday!
And that's the ballgame! What a night in Dallas!
That one's going to sting. A tough night at the Cotton Bowl.
